title: chaenactis achilleifolia var. douglasii
intro: Chaenactis achilleifolia var. douglasii, commonly known as Douglas' whiteflower, is a plant species in the daisy family. It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic. The therapeutic actions of Douglas' whiteflower include soothing digestive issues, reducing pain and inflammation, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
